你得往这机器里放两枚 20 便士的硬币。

zh: 21 岁生日；21 岁生日庆典
en: a person’s 21st birthday and the celebrations for this occasion
ex: She’s having a party on her twenty-first.
她二十一次正在开派对。

zh: 一天二十四小时，一星期七天（用以表示 “全天候”）
en: twenty-four hours a day, seven days a week (used to mean ‘all the time’)
ex: He's on duty twenty-four seven.
他不分昼夜地天天上班。

en: the ability to see perfectly
ex: You need twenty-twenty vision for this job.
您需要这份二十二的远见。

en: to dance to popular music with the body bent low and the hips moving forwards and backwards
a type of dancing to popular music with the body bent low and the hips moving forwards and backwards
a stupid or annoying person
ex: Don’t be such a twerp!
别这么笨拙！

en: two times; on two occasions
ex: I don't know him well; I've only met him twice.
我跟他不熟悉，只见过两次面。

zh: （常因紧张或无聊）旋弄，摆弄，捻弄（物件）
en: to twist or turn something with your fingers often because you are nervous or bored
ex: He twiddled with the radio knob until he found the right programme.
他转动了一会儿收音机旋钮才找到了合意的节目。

en: detailed or complicated
ex: The piece of music contains some twiddly guitar solos.
这首乐曲包含一些颤抖的吉他独奏。

en: a small, very thin branch that grows out of a larger branch on a bush or tree
the small amount of light or the period of time at the end of the day after the sun has gone down
ex: It was hard to see him clearly in the twilight.
在朦胧的暮色中很难看清他。

zh: 暮色苍茫的；昏暗朦胧的
en: lit by twilight
ex: She hurried out into the twilit street.
她匆匆出来，走进暮色苍茫的街道。

en: a type of strong cloth that is made in a particular way to produce a surface of raised diagonal lines
ex: a cotton twill skirt
斜纹布裙子

zh: 孪生儿之一；双胞胎之一
en: one of two children born at the same time to the same mother
ex: She's expecting twins.
她怀着双胞胎。

en: one of a pair of single beds in a room
ex: Would you prefer twin beds or a double?
你们喜欢一对单人床还是一张双人床？

zh: （旅馆等的）有两张单人床的房间
en: a room in a hotel, etc. that has two single beds
